ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
<image>In $\odot X, A B=30, C D=30,$ and $m \widehat{C Z}=40$
Find $m\widehat{D Z}$
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Geometry3K open-ended question

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a circle with X as the center. C and D are the two endpoints of the same chord, and Z is located on the circumference and on the minor arc CD. Segment XZ extends from the center X to Z on the circumference, and intersects chord CD at N; there is a right-angle mark at N, indicating that XZ is perpendicular to chord CD. The problem gives m\widehat{CZ}=40 and asks for m\widehat{DZ}. Reasoning: In a circle, if a radius or diameter perpendicular to a chord is drawn from the center, then it bisects that chord and also bisects the minor arc intercepted by that chord. Because XZ is perpendicular to chord CD, and Z is on the minor arc CD, Z is the midpoint of the minor arc CD. Therefore \widehat{CZ}=\widehat{DZ}. Given m\widehat{CZ}=40, so m\widehat{DZ}=40.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: circle has center X, C and D are endpoints of a chord, Z is a point on the circle between C and D on the minor arc, and segment XZ intersects chord CD at N with a right-angle mark, so XZ is perpendicular to chord CD. From the text, read that m arc CZ = 40 and the target is m arc DZ. Use the circle theorem that a radius or diameter perpendicular to a chord bisects both the chord and the intercepted arc. Therefore Z bisects minor arc CD, so arc CZ = arc DZ. Since arc CZ is 40, arc DZ is 40.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是以 X 为圆心的圆。C 和 D 是同一条弦的两个端点，Z 位于圆周上并在小弧 CD 上。线段 XZ 从圆心 X 延伸到圆周上的 Z，并在 N 处与弦 CD 相交；N 处有直角标记，表示 XZ 垂直于弦 CD。题目给出 m\widehat{CZ}=40，要求 m\widehat{DZ}。

推理：在圆中，若从圆心作一条垂直于弦的半径或直径，则它会平分该弦，也会平分该弦所截的小弧。因为 XZ 垂直于弦 CD，且 Z 在小弧 CD 上，所以 Z 是小弧 CD 的中点。因此 \widehat{CZ}=\widehat{DZ}。已知 m\widehat{CZ}=40，所以 m\widehat{DZ}=40。

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as showing X as the center of the circle, C and D on the circle, chord CD crossing segment XZ at N, and a right angle at N between XZ and CD. Because XC and XD are radii, XC = XD. Also, triangles XNC and XND are right triangles sharing leg XN, with hypotenuses XC and XD equal. Thus the two right triangles are congruent, so angle CXZ equals angle ZXD. Equal central angles intercept equal arcs, so arc CZ equals arc DZ. The text gives m arc CZ = 40, hence m arc DZ = 40.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是圆 X，X 标在圆内作为圆心；C、D、Z 都在圆周上。弦 CD 从左下方的 C 连到右侧的 D，并与从圆心 X 指向圆周点 Z 的线段 XZ 相交于点 N。图中在 N 处标出直角，表示 XZ 垂直于 CD。

推理：因为 X 是圆心，所以 XC 和 XD 都是半径，故 XC = XD。三角形 XNC 和 XND 都是直角三角形，它们共用直角边 XN，并且斜边 XC = XD。因此两个直角三角形全等，得到中心角 ∠CXZ 与 ∠ZXD 相等。相等的中心角截得相等的弧，所以弧 CZ = 弧 DZ。已知 m弧CZ = 40，因此 m弧DZ = 40。
